id: # The sites of the map of the Eastern Han in 196: 42 cities (id 0 to 41), 10 passes (42 to 51) and 35 ports (52 to 86), the same counts as the placeholder pack.

# Most cities are the seats of commanderies and of states of the Han. The pack chose the 42 cities from the novel Romance of the Three Kingdoms, with the places of its major battles first. Liucheng, Hefei and Jianye are not seats in 196, but the novel tells of their battles. The list does not come from another game.
# lat and lon: degrees, WGS84. The positions are the sites of the Han towns or of the modern cities on those sites. These facts are common knowledge. Wikidata (CC0) has the same values.
# slots: the number of development slots that the tool tries to place. specialty: the specialty of cities.tsv. Passes and ports use -.
# owner: the city id of a pass or a port. - = the nearest city.
# across: the city id on the other side of a pass. The gate guards the owner city against it. - = the nearest city behind the gate.
